description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's whitespace and diff behaviors. It sets up a repository, performs various diff operations with whitespace considerations, and checks the exit codes to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks for the expected outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, verifying its non-zero exit status.

methods.name: test_must_pass
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to succeed, verifying its zero exit status.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances Git's internal timestamp to ensure commit order.
